name: Paper trading of crypto portfolio v7 (Gen109: v6 + ridge ML)
registered: 2026-10-20, before the first v7 paper hour; runs side by side with v5/v6 (which stay frozen)
what: Hourly forward test of v7 = v6 + the Gen108/109 ridge ML sleeve (BTC/ETH perps: ridge regression on 17 daily features, refit monthly on all earlier data, prediction / training sd clipped to +-1, position 0.5 x prediction, decided at the 00:00 UTC close, 5 bp taker + funding). Same construction as v6: point-in-time equal risk (Weiss half weight), 30-day vol targeting. Simulation only.

frozen.daily_stop: flat for the rest of the UTC day once the day's loss reaches 50% of the firm's 5% daily loss limit (2.5%), exit 10 bp worse (Gen230 setting)
frozen.costs: as in research: C* 7.5 bp, premium carry / trend / Weiss 5 bp taker, cascade 2 bp maker entry + 5 bp exit, real funding; deleveraging bounce and ridge ML 5 bp taker + funding
frozen.booking: cascade entry fee in the fill hour and Weiss legs as each bar closes (live=True); same totals as research
frozen.risk_note: Gen230/236: 2.0 in the challenge, 1.5 once funded; the paper ledger runs at the challenge risk
frozen.ridge_inputs: Binance 5m/funding/premium/open interest (as v6), Coinbase BTC/ETH hourly, Upbit KRW hourly + Yahoo USD/KRW (kimchi, Gen105 strict London dating, previous day's FX), Deribit DVOL daily, Coin Metrics USDT+USDC caps (2-day lag); scripts/ridge_live.py, live feeds src/qpl/live/ml_feeds.py
frozen.v7_scale_note: 0.15 / realised vol of the point-in-time v7 series 2022-26 (computed 2026-10-20 by paper_v5.py _dump on the research pack, same method as v5/v6)

frozen_ledger: Each completed hour is computed once, with only the data available at that moment, and never revised. Hours computed more than 2 hours after they closed are flagged late.

gate.minimum: 56 days of paper results and at least 2 Weiss expiry events
gate.reconciliation: recompute the period with the final data: hourly portfolio P&L correlation >= 0.99 and |cumulative difference| <= 0.5% of the account; otherwise find and fix the cause before going further
gate.operations: late or missed hours <= 5% of hours; no data errors
gate.performance: z = (paper mean daily return - backtest mean) / (backtest daily sd / sqrt(days)), backtest = v7 2023-01..2026-09 at the same risk. GO if z > -1; EXTEND to 112 days if -2 <= z <= -1; STOP if z < -2 or the paper drawdown is worse than -12%
gate.honesty_note: 56 days cannot prove the edge (one standard error is about the whole expected return). The paper test mainly proves that the pipeline runs live without look-ahead, data gaps or execution surprises.
